_comment: The single list of everything Lectern watches or may watch, and what kind of thing each is. Every form of Lectern (the Python, n8n and the others in forms/) reads this file and none copies it. config/sources.json, the schools in config/faculty_config.json and the seeds in config/biolabs.json are generated from it by ops/build_from_targets.py; lectern/TARGETS.md's tables are generated from it too. Edit here, then run that script. A form that finds a company writes a proposal (forms/<form>/proposed-targets.jsonl) and never edits this file; a person promotes it. Removed targets stay, with the reason, so a discovery agent is shown what Professor Bear has already ruled out. Written 2026-10-20 by moving the lists that were spread over sources.json, faculty_config.json, biolabs.json and TARGETS.md.
